# TEMPORARY: unreleased `@sidevoice/voice`

`sidevoice-voice-<sha>.tgz` is the npm package that sidevoice-voice CI built for PR #31 (artifact
`voice-npm-<sha>`) at the commit named in the file. It carries the per-conversation call API
(`createCall`/`routeInput`) that no published version has yet. It is replaced by the published
`@sidevoice/voice` 0.5.0 before this branch merges, and this directory is then deleted.
